$comment: Single source of truth for the typed IPC boundary. Edit this file, then run `npm run codegen` to regenerate src/api/ipc.generated.ts. Type expressions: string | number | boolean | null | any | unknown | void | `T[]` | `Record<string, T>` | anything else passes through raw TS. Named interfaces shared across commands live in `types` (name + raw TS body, may reference each other for recursion).

types.name: ContentNode
types.shape: id: string; kind: string; position: number; number: string | null; title: string | null; release_date: string | null; duration_min: number | null; page_count: number | null; synopsis: string | null; is_special: boolean; state: string | null; children: ContentNode[]

types.name: TrackingView
types.shape: media_id: string; core_status: string; custom_status_id: string | null; started_at: string | null; finished_at: string | null; repeat_count: number; updated_at: string

types.name: ProgressSummary
types.shape: percent: number | null; completed: number; total: number; next_label: string | null; next_node_id: string | null

commands.name: greet
commands.doc: Placeholder greeting command (create-tauri-app scaffold). Resolves with the greeting or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_create
commands.doc: Create a media entry from manual input. Resolves with the new media id or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_list
commands.returns: { id: string; content_type: string; title: string; pub_status: string; release_year: number | null; cover_asset_id: string | null; updated_at: string; progress: ProgressSummary }[]
commands.doc: List library entries with optional filters. Resolves with summary rows (each carrying its progress summary for the in-grid quick controls) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_facets
commands.returns: { formats: string[]; genres: { id: string; name: string }[]; tags: { id: string; name: string }[]; years: number[] }
commands.doc: Distinct filter values present in the library. Resolves with facet options or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_get
commands.returns: { id: string; content_type: string; format: string | null; title_main: string; title_original: string | null; synopsis: string | null; pub_status: string; start_date: string | null; end_date: string | null; release_year: number | null; language: string | null; country: string | null; content_rating: string | null; pages: number | null; duration_min: number | null; ep_count: number | null; ch_count: number | null; cover_asset_id: string | null; banner_asset_id: string | null; provider: string | null; provider_url: string | null; metadata_refreshed_at: string | null; created_at: string; updated_at: string; alt_titles: { lang: string; title: string }[]; people: string[]; genres: string[]; tags: string[]; external_ids: { provider: string; ext_id: string; url: string | null }[]; relations: { to_id: string; relation: string }[] } | null
commands.doc: Read the full aggregate for one media. Resolves with the record or null when not found; rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_search
commands.returns: { id: string; content_type: string; title: string; pub_status: string; release_year: number | null; cover_asset_id: string | null; updated_at: string; progress: ProgressSummary }[]
commands.doc: Local full-text search over the library. Resolves with summary rows (each carrying its progress summary) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_nodes
commands.doc: Read the full content tree for one media (seasons→episodes, volumes→chapters) with per-node progress state. Resolves with the nested tree, roots ordered by position, or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: node_progress_set
commands.doc: Set the progress state of one node (read/watched/skipped/unread). Completed states stamp read_at. Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: node_progress_range
commands.doc: Set the progress state of every node between two nodes in the media's display order. Resolves with the affected node ids (for optimistic UI) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: node_progress_next
commands.doc: Mark the next not-yet-consumed countable node of a media done (watched for episodes, read otherwise) and run the auto-status rule. Resolves with the refreshed progress summary, null when nothing is left to mark, or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: tracking_get
commands.doc: Read the tracking row for one media. Resolves with the row or null when the media is untracked; rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: tracking_set_status
commands.doc: Apply a status transition for one media (status engine applies, incl. the Repeat guard and started/finished stamps). Resolves with the updated row or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_delete
commands.doc: Soft-delete a media: store its before-image in trash, cascade the row away. Resolves with the trash id (accepted by trash_restore for undo) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: trash_list
commands.returns: { id: string; kind: string; title: string; deleted_at: string }[]
commands.doc: List active (not restored) trash entries. Resolves with trash items or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: trash_restore
commands.doc: Restore a soft-deleted aggregate from its trash before-image. Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: trash_purge
commands.doc: Permanently forget a trash entry. Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: tracking_bulk_set_status
commands.doc: Set the tracking status for many media at once (status engine applies). Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_bulk_add_tag
commands.doc: Add a personal tag to many media at once (reused or created as needed). Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_bulk_delete
commands.doc: Soft-delete many media. Resolves with a trash id per media (for group undo) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: collection_list
commands.doc: List collections for the add-to-list picker. Resolves with collection rows or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: collection_bulk_add
commands.doc: Add many media to one collection. Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.
